name: fiendish_panda_reads_its_last_power_counters_included
notes: M3 mapper. Printed: 'When this creature dies, return another target non-Bear creature card with mana value less than or equal to this creature's power from your graveyard to the battlefield.' Fiendish Panda (printed 3/2) has two +1/+1 counters, so its power is 5 when it dies; 'this creature's power' is read as it last existed on the battlefield (CR 608.2h), counters included. Seat 0's graveyard holds a mana value 5 creature card and a mana value 6 one: the 5 comes back, the 6 stays.
